description: The first touch of DLCworkshop01's strings is a new one: a description set where the record had none, before any localized value of the plugin was read. Whether the tables in DLCworkshop01 - Main.ba2 are loaded first (TwbLocalizationHandler.LoadForFile through GetValue) or AddValue makes three new, empty tables that the save writes over the plugin's is what the real load sequence of the oracle decides; the port must save the same plugin and tables.
